instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Show my decisions, what I am working toward, my plans and what has helped me decide", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:see-my-decisions and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Reads your own rows and answers the Decisions screen: your newest decisions (at most 100) as summaries with the pursuits each cites, where each stands and how far it has got (decided, next action carried out, result checked); your current pursuits as the tree they nest into (from your record-scope choice rows); your newest plans; and what has helped you (which questions changed your answers and how those decisions turned out).

4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: decision (records:read, records:list); decision-revision (records:read); decision-step (records:read); decision-evidence (records:read); decision-answered-step (records:read); decision-option (records:read); decision-candidate (records:read); decision-report (records:read); decision-carried-out (records:read); decision-history (records:read); decision-cited-pursuit (records:read); decision-method (records:read); decision-part (records:read); decision-refs (records:read); pursuit (records:read, records:list); record-scope (records:read); record-stance (records:read); plan (records:list); record:check (records:list); setting (records:list).
